text.tspan: GAP-MW-013: Functional signal names, units, freshness criteria, and conversion rules are not yet enumerated.
GAP-MW-014: Lifecycle state vocabulary and transition timing are not yet baselined.
GAP-MW-015: Functional ownership of safety-path protection remains unresolved until logical architecture and safety analysis.
Functional request for a vehicle signal required by an ADAS application use case.
Functional response containing a vehicle signal value and its health/freshness status.
Functional request for middleware or vehicle diagnostic status.
Functional diagnostic status returned to the ADAS application.
Functional lifecycle request exchanged between the ADAS application and middleware boundary.
Functional lifecycle state made observable at the integration boundary.
Functional health and availability status forwarded to the ADAS application.
Functional request or notification for middleware integration update coordination.
Functional status indicating whether an update preserves required integration interfaces.
Functional request to discover and bind a required middleware service.
Functional result of service discovery, authentication, and binding.
Functional status indicating whether non-safety middleware failure is contained at the intervention boundary.
Reviewers need the functional responsibilities, information items,
flows, and sequencing for the feature increment to be visible
Reviewers need the functional boundary ports, signal character,
direction, producer/consumer mapping, and upstreaming posture
for DE4SDV candidate VSS extension signals.
